[SWS_DM_01392] SOVD method Stop the Execution of an Oper- ation
⌈
For each DiagnosticRoutine with DiagnosticStopRoutine the SOVD
Server Instance shall provide the SOVD method Stop the Execution of an Op-
eration according to SOVD SOVD[2]. The Diagnostic Server instance shall
execute the method analog to Service RoutineControl (0x31) with Stop (0x02) of ISO
14229-1[1] using the same instance of the processing mechanism.
⌋

⌈
For each DiagnosticRoutine with DiagnosticStopRoutine the SOVD Server
Instance shall provide the SOVD method Stop the Execution of an Operation
according to SOVD SOVD[4]. The Diagnostic Server instance shall execute the
method analog to Service RoutineControl (0x31) with Stop (0x02) of ISO 14229-1[1]
using the same instance of the processing mechanism.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01392] Support of SOVD method Terminate execution of an Operation
⌈
For each DiagnosticSovdOperationStop,
the Diagnostic Server in-
stance shall provide the SOVD method Terminate execution of an Opera-
tion according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
⌋
